faqs.question: What is The Pi School?
faqs.answer: The Pi School offers personalized, high-quality math tutoring for students of all levels from foundational skills to advanced classes like AP Calculus. We offer one-on-one, semi-private, and group sessions both in person and online.

faqs.question: What types of classes are offered?
faqs.answer: Private Tutoring - One-on-one support tailored to your needs. Semi-Private Tutoring - 2 students sessions for peers at similar levels. Group Tutoring - Larger sessions (3+ students) ideal for similar-level collaborative learning.

faqs.question: Where are classes held?
faqs.answer: Most classes are held online, but some in person accommodations can be worked out in Bothell and Redmond.

faqs.question: How long are the sessions and how often do they occur?
faqs.answer: Each session is 1 hour long and typically held once a week. Frequency can be adjusted based on need.

faqs.question: Can I join with friends for group sessions?
faqs.answer: Yes! If your friends are at similar math levels, group lessons are a great way to learn together. If not, consider semi-private or individual tutoring.

faqs.question: What happens during a typical class?
faqs.answer: Classes include a review of school topics, reinforcement of key math concepts, and problem-solving based on student needs. Homework help is always welcome.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the scheduled session are not eligible for refunds or make-up classes.
